GenMark Diagnostics, Inc., a molecular diagnostics company, develops and commercializes molecular tests based on its proprietary eSensor electrochemical detection technology. The company has market cap of $281.46 million. The firm provides XT-8 instrument, and related diagnostic and research tests, as well as certain custom manufactured reagents that enable reference laboratories and hospitals to support a range of molecular tests with a workstation and disposable test cartridges. It currently has negative earnings. It offers diagnostic tests for use with its XT-8 system that includes respiratory viral panel, cystic fibrosis genotyping test, warfarin sensitivity test, and thrombophilia risk test, as well as HCV genotyping test and associated custom manufactured reagents, and 2C19 genotyping test.
The stock decreased 2.52% or $0.13 during the last trading session, reaching $5.03. About 376,552 shares traded. GenMark Diagnostics, Inc. (NASDAQ:GNMK) has declined 18.16% since December 8, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 33.78% the S&P500.
